settings.title: Izilungiselelo
settings.subtitle: Gcina izilungiselelo zesikrini nesihlungi noma uzihlele kabusha. Zonke izilungiselelo zigcinwa kuphela kulesi siphequluli.
settings.rating.title: Isikali sokulinganisa
settings.language.title: Ulimi
settings.language.desc: Ulimi lwe-UI lwamamenyu namathegi. (Okuqukethwe komsebenzi kuhlala ku-oda lokuqala laseKorea.)
settings.filters.remember.desc: Gcina izilinganiso, izincomo, nezihlungi zekhalenda phakathi nokuvakashelwa.
settings.filters.clear.desc: Susa izihlungi ezigciniwe kuwo wonke amakhasi.
settings.age.title: Ukubonakala kwebhodi labadala
settings.age.description: Amabhodi abantu abadala abonakala ngemva kokuqinisekiswa kweminyaka.
settings.data.exportDesc: Gcina izilinganiso, isimo sokufunda, izibhalisi, nokuqoqwa ku-JSON.
settings.data.importDesc: Buyisela kusuka kufayela lokulondoloza bese ubhala kabusha idatha yesiphequluli samanje.
settings.data.recentDesc: Sula izihloko zakamuva eziboniswa Ekhaya, Umtapo Wezincwadi, naseKusesheni.
settings.data.searchDesc: Sula amagama angukhiye asanda kusetshenziswa esikrinini sokucinga.
settings.data.resetDesc: Susa izilinganiso, umlando wokufunda, okubhaliselwe, namaqoqo. Akukwazi ukuhlehliswa.
settings.data.importError: Ayikwazi ukufunda ifayela. Qinisekisa ukuthi ifayela lesipele elivumelekile.
settings.account.title: Ukuphathwa kwe-akhawunti · ukushiya isevisi
settings.account.desc: Ukuhlela iphrofayela nokususwa kwe-akhawunti kuyatholakala ekhasini lakho lephrofayela. Ukususwa kukukhipha ngemvume ngokushesha.
